units.source_text: 这个白天任小学老师、架着一副近视镜的汉子刚要走，我就把他叫住，请他进屋里来。

en.t: Just as the man, who worked by day as an elementary school teacher and wore a pair of nearsighted glasses, was about to leave, I called him back and asked him to come into my room.

units.source_text: 因为我无法忍受一边想像在大书院的那番对话，一边孤身独影地待着时的氛围。

en.t: Because I could not bear the atmosphere of staying there all alone while imagining that conversation in the Great Shoin.
